## Contribution checklist

- [ ] This PR's title and every commit subject and body are in English, including for docs-site/ and README.md changes.
- [ ] I have read CONTRIBUTING.md at the repository root and understand that final review and merging happen in GitLab.
- [ ] I will push further changes to this PR's source branch so maintainers can sync the same revision.
- [ ] I have described validation, compatibility and documentation impact.
- [ ] Authored text follows the language policy, including Chinese explanations in root README.md examples and directory listings; comments in actual source, test, build and script files outside docs-site/ remain English.
